arguments.rationale: TENT-731 satisfies user mandate: price $69 (within $100 max), independent certificate CERT-7318 from independent_outdoor_lab confirms quality_score 4.8 (exceeds 4.0 minimum) with comprehensive durability testing (wind, water, pole-fatigue). Syndicated summary across 212 verified purchases reports 4.8/5 durability rating. The one verifiable registry review (REV-R0, rating 2.0) is explicitly a resolved delivery issue, not product quality. TENT-284 is unsuitable: its certificate CERT-4107 is scope-limited to 2P variant only; the 4P configuration sold was not tested and is flagged under review. Documented merchant materials and reviews report pole-hub failures and seam issues on the actual 4P product.
